posts.title: A railway project is never just about the railway.
posts.text: Tanzania has secured $1.2 billion in commercial financing for the Tabora to Kigoma section of its Standard Gauge Railway. The 411 km line will connect western production areas to the wider rail network and Dar es Salaam, while improving links toward the DRC and Burundi. What interests us is what can grow around infrastructure like this.

posts.title: Sometimes entering a new market doesn’t mean doing everything alone.
posts.text: A joint venture can bring together capital, local knowledge, distribution and operating experience, but the relationship needs to be clear before the opportunity gets exciting. Who would matter more to you in a new market: a capital partner or an operating partner?
